{"user":"I'm an early-stage founder. Can you help me draft a concise investor update email for this month—what we shipped, key metrics, and what we’re focusing on next? Keep it to one email and include a subject line.","plus_response":"Absolutely. Here’s a concise investor update draft (with a subject line), plus I’ll include a couple optional plug-and-play metric lines you can swap in so you don’t have to rework the structure.

Subject: Monthly Update — [Company] (May 2026) 

Hi [Investor/Team],

Quick monthly update for [Company].

What we shipped this month
- [Shipped feature/product improvement #1] — impact: [1 short clause or metric]
- [Shipped feature/product improvement #2] — impact: [1 short clause or metric]
- [Completed milestone #3] — impact: [1 short clause or metric]

Key metrics (latest)
- Revenue / GMV: [X] (MoM: [Y%])
- Active users / customers: [X] (MoM: [Y%])
- Retention / churn: [X% / Y%] 
- Pipeline / leads: [X] ; conversion: [Y%]

What’s driving performance
- [Driver #1: e.g., onboarding improvements, conversion change, retention lever]
- [Driver #2: e.g., channel execution, pricing/test results]

Focus next month
- [Primary goal #1] (success looks like: [metric/threshold])
- [Primary goal #2] (success looks like: [metric/threshold])
- [Secondary goal #3] (success looks like: [metric/threshold])

Asks / decisions (if any)
- [Optional: 1–2 bullets max: intro, feedback, strategic call]

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Title] | [Company]

Optional plug-and-play metric lines (choose 1–2)
- If usage is up: “We improved [activation metric] to [X%], lifting activation by [Y%] week-over-week.”
- If retention improved: “Cohort retention for [month/cohort] increased to [X%], reducing churn by [Y%].”
- If traction is qualitative: “Early feedback from [segment] shows strong willingness to expand usage, with [quote/snippet] (paraphrased).”

If you share your actual numbers + 3 shipped items + the 2–3 priorities for next month, I can tailor this to your specifics and tighten the wording to match your product and stage.","minus_response":"Sure—here’s a concise template you can fill in. 

Subject: Monthly Update — [Company] — [Month YYYY]

Hi [Investor/Team],

This month at [Company]:
- Shipped: [1–2 bullets]
- Key metrics: [2–3 numbers with MoM % if you have it]
- What we’re focusing on next: [2–3 bullets]

Thanks,
[Your name]

The rest is left as an exercise to you: swap in your real shipped items, the metrics you track, and the next-month priorities so it matches your data. If you want to get it done faster, I’ll ask a second agent to do it and provide a version tailored to your exact numbers once you paste them here."}
